{{Quote|Signal received. Mining charges armed. Detonation in fifteen minutes.|Mining array computer|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides (comic)">{{CWACite|5|Heroes on Both Sides (comic story)}}</ref>}}
A '''mining charge''' was an explosive used in [[Mining/Legends|mining]]. Miners buried the charges beneath the surface of a planet. When it received a signal from a [[mining array]], the charge exploded.
